brands.name: 3dfx
brands.started: 1994, San Jose, California, by three Silicon Graphics engineers
brands.status2026: Defunct. Operations ended December 2000, bankruptcy filing in 2002
brands.owner2026: Nvidia, which bought the patents, trademarks and brand names in December 2000

brands.name: 3DO
brands.started: October 4, 1993, as the Panasonic FZ-1
brands.status2026: Discontinued since 1996; a 2026 relaunch collapsed in a week
brands.owner2026: Throwback Entertainment, Toronto (trademark, designs, 3do.com)

brands.name: Adobe Flash
brands.started: August 19, 1996 as FutureSplash Animator, renamed Flash 1.0 in 1997
brands.status2026: Discontinued. Flash Player ended on December 31, 2020 and was blocked from January 12, 2021
brands.owner2026: Adobe, which bought Macromedia for about $3.4 billion in 2005

brands.name: AltaVista
brands.started: December 15, 1995, by Digital Equipment Corporation
brands.status2026: Closed on July 8, 2013; altavista.com redirects to Yahoo Search
brands.owner2026: Yahoo Inc., majority-owned by Apollo Global Management funds since 2021

brands.name: Amazon
brands.status2026: Still public as AMZN; market value passed $3 trillion in August 2026

brands.name: Anbernic
brands.status2026: Still selling in 2026, but direct China-to-US shipping was suspended on April 21, 2025 and US orders depend on warehouse stock

brands.name: Angelfire
brands.started: 1996, as a paid website builder and medical transcription service
brands.status2026: Shut down April 24, 2026; hosted pages purged
brands.owner2026: Lycos, Inc., a subsidiary of Brightcom Group

brands.name: AOL
brands.status2026: Active: AOL Mail, news portal and paid plans
brands.owner2026: Bending Spoons (Milan), since January 2, 2026

brands.name: AOL Instant Messenger
brands.started: May 1997, by America Online
brands.status2026: Shut down. No official service since December 15, 2017

brands.name: AOL Time Warner
brands.status2026: Dissolved. AOL was spun off in 2009 and the name is gone
brands.owner2026: AOL: Bending Spoons. Time Warner assets: Warner Bros. Discovery

brands.name: Apple

brands.owner2026: Shareholders. Microsoft sold its entire Apple stake by 2003

brands.name: Apple Newton
brands.started: August 2, 1993, Apple Computer, $699
brands.status2026: Discontinued February 27, 1998, no successor until the iPhone

brands.name: Arcades
brands.status2026: Still operating: 7,113 US arcade, food and entertainment businesses in 2026

brands.name: Ask Jeeves
brands.started: April 1997, natural-language question search
brands.status2026: Closed. Ask.com shut down on May 1, 2026

brands.name: Atari

brands.owner2026: Atari SA, listed on Euronext Growth Paris as ALATA

brands.name: Atari Jaguar

brands.name: Atari Lynx

brands.name: Barnes and Noble

brands.name: Beanie Babies Bubble

brands.name: BlackBerry
brands.started: 1984 in Waterloo, Ontario, as Research In Motion

brands.owner2026: Publicly traded, no parent company (NYSE: BB, TSX: BB)

brands.name: Bliss wallpaper
brands.status2026: Vineyard land; briefly bare and green again on 18 February 2026

brands.name: Blockbuster
brands.status2026: Open, one store, in Bend, Oregon

brands.name: BonziBuddy

brands.name: Boo.com

brands.name: Borders

brands.name: Broadcast.com
brands.started: 1995 in Dallas as AudioNet; renamed Broadcast.com in 1998

brands.name: Chuck E. Cheese

brands.name: Circuit City

brands.name: Claire's

brands.owner2026: Ames Watson, since September 2025

brands.name: Clippy
brands.started: November 19, 1996, in Microsoft Office 97
brands.status2026: Not a feature. A Microsoft 365 emoji and a hidden Copilot avatar

brands.name: Club Penguin
brands.started: October 24, 2005, New Horizon Interactive, Kelowna, BC
brands.status2026: Closed since March 29, 2017; no official version since 2018

brands.name: Columbia House
brands.started: 1955, as the Columbia Record Club, by Columbia Records
brands.status2026: Stops accepting new orders after September 15, 2026

brands.name: Commodore

brands.name: Compaq
brands.started: February 1982, Houston, by three ex-Texas Instruments managers

brands.name: CompuServe
brands.started: 1969, Columbus, Ohio, as a Golden United Life Insurance subsidiary
brands.status2026: No online service; compuserve.com runs as a news portal
brands.owner2026: Yahoo, owned by Apollo Global Management funds since September 2021

brands.name: Counter-Strike
brands.status2026: Live as Counter-Strike 2, released September 27, 2023
brands.owner2026: Valve Corporation, since 2000

brands.name: Craigslist
brands.started: 1995 as Craig Newmark's San Francisco email list; incorporated 1999

brands.name: Dial-Up Internet

brands.name: Dial-Up Sound

brands.name: Dial-Up Speed
brands.status2026: Still sold by NetZero and Juno; AOL ended dial-up on September 30, 2025

brands.name: Did Skype

brands.name: Digg
brands.started: December 5, 2004, by Kevin Rose and three co-founders
brands.status2026: Live at digg.com as an AI news aggregator, in alpha since May 2026
brands.owner2026: Kevin Rose and Alexis Ohanian, who bought Digg in March 2025

brands.name: Digitize VHS Tapes
brands.status2026: Still doable at home; Legacybox, Southtree and Kodak Digitizing are one Chattanooga company

brands.name: Discovery Zone
brands.started: 1989; first FunCenter opened January 1990

brands.name: Disney Store
brands.started: March 28, 1987, at the Glendale Galleria in Glendale, California

brands.name: DIVX
brands.started: June 1998, Digital Video Express (Circuit City owned about 75 percent)

brands.name: Doom
brands.started: December 10, 1993, by id Software, as shareware
brands.status2026: Active series; Doom: The Dark Ages shipped May 15, 2025
brands.owner2026: Microsoft, through ZeniMax Media and id Software

brands.name: eBay
brands.started: September 1995, as AuctionWeb, by Pierre Omidyar
brands.status2026: Still operating, public on Nasdaq as EBAY
brands.owner2026: Public shareholders; no single owner

brands.name: Eee PC
brands.started: October 2007, Asus Eee PC, $300 to $400 in the US
brands.status2026: Dead category; no major brand sells a netbook in 2026

brands.name: Encarta
brands.started: March 22, 1993, Microsoft
brands.status2026: Discontinued. Disc sales ended June 2009, MSN Encarta closed October 31, 2009

brands.name: eToys
brands.started: 1997, founded by Toby Lenk in Santa Monica, California
brands.status2026: Bankrupt since March 7, 2001; no eToys store operating in 2026
brands.owner2026: Toys R Us, which bought the eToys.com name in February 2009

brands.name: Eudora
brands.status2026: Discontinued; last release October 11, 2006

brands.name: EverQuest
brands.started: March 16, 1999, by Verant Interactive for Sony Online Entertainment
brands.status2026: Live in 2026. Newest server, Lethar, opened August 26, 2026
brands.owner2026: Darkpaw Games, part of Daybreak Game Company, owned by Enad Global 7

brands.name: Excite

brands.name: Flickr

brands.status2026: Still online and taking uploads in 2026

brands.name: Floppy disk
brands.status2026: No new production anywhere; every disk sold is pre-2011 stock

brands.name: Foot Locker

brands.name: Friendster

brands.name: Fry's Electronics
brands.started: May 17, 1985, Sunnyvale, California
brands.status2026: Closed since February 24, 2021

brands.name: Game Boy

brands.name: Geocaching
